headline: TrendForce expects NAND contract prices to fall from 1Q27
quote: TrendForce forecasts overall NAND flash contract prices falling by 0-5 percent quarter on quarter in early 2027
claim: TrendForce forecasts NAND flash contract prices to fall 0-5 percent QoQ in early 2027, with all product categories in a downturn from the second quarter, as Chinese cloud operators cut enterprise SSD orders.
why_it_matters: SSD prices may ease in 2027, but TrendForce says cheaper flash won't fix the DRAM squeeze, so laptop RAM upgrades stay costly.
title: NAND prices tipped to fall as Chinese cloud giants cut SSD orders

headline: NAND spot prices fell about 20% in two weeks
quote: TrendForce has lowered its forecast for contract price increases in the fourth quarter of 2026 to 8–13%
claim: TrendForce cut its 4Q26 NAND contract price increase forecast to 8-13%, and spot prices have recently fallen by more than 20% as distributors clear inventory.
why_it_matters: Spot SSD and flash costs are already softening, so waiting on an SSD purchase may pay off.
title: NAND flash prices set to fall in 2027 as Chinese cloud firms cut or...

headline: Microsoft raises Indian cloud prices 15.7% from January 2027
quote: face an increase of 15.7 percent for cloud services and up to 20 percent for some on-prem offerings
claim: Microsoft's new charges take effect January 1, 2027; customers in India face a 15.7 percent increase for cloud services and up to 20 percent for some on-prem offerings.
why_it_matters: Azure credits and cloud bills in India get costlier from January, which matters for student projects on paid tiers.
title: Microsoft lifts Indian cloud prices by 15 percent, cuts costs in China
